title: Do I Need an SSL Certificate for My Website, Blog, or eCommerce Store?

facts.fact: According to the page, SSL certificates use two cryptographic keys, a public key for encryption and a private key for decryption.
facts.quote: The way these certificates work is that they use two cryptographic keys for encryption and decryption.

facts.fact: According to the page, only certain companies called Certificate Authorities (CAs) can issue legitimate SSL certificates.
facts.quote: Only certain companies, called Certificate Authorities (CAs), can issue legitimate SSL certificates.

facts.fact: The article is listed as a 7-minute read.
According to the page, Google Chrome labels websites without SSL as unsecure.
facts.quote: Google Chrome browsers do label unsecure websites as such
